metadata.description: Tools for cycling race promoters and teams: BikeReg event data, race and social media review decks, and poster mailing.

plugins.name: bikereg-registrations
plugins.description: Ask for BikeReg event IDs (up to 20) and get one verified CSV of every registration: name, category, gender, team, city, state, reg date.

plugins.name: race-review-deck
plugins.description: Turn BikeReg registration CSVs and a race logo into a post-race review deck (.pptx): category, gender, location, team, registration-timing and retention trends, year over year, with outliers and takeaways.

plugins.name: bike-shop-poster-mailer
plugins.description: Find every bike shop within a radius of a ZIP code and get a USPS Click-N-Ship bulk-label CSV to mail them posters or flyers. Asks for the ZIP, radius, package and return address one question at a time.

plugins.name: social-review-deck
plugins.description: Turn Meta (Instagram/Facebook) post exports and a logo into a social media review deck (.pptx) for a bike race: year over year, top posts collage, best post types, hashtags, partners and timing, with an optional focus on one account, sponsor or hashtag.
